{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1].copy()

# Check how many have valid age (not -1)
valid_age_count = len(converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1])
invalid_age_count = len(converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] == -1])

print(f"Total converted customers: {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"With valid age (not -1): {valid_age_count}")
print(f"With age = -1: {invalid_age_count}")

# Compute mean age, excluding -1
mean_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
